plan.title: Add documentation browser TreeView sections to sidebar
plan.overview: Implement two new collapsible TreeView sections ("Product Docs" and "Engineering Docs") that mirror the folder hierarchy of .kanban/product/ and .kanban/engineering/ respectively. Following the existing global-actions-view.capability.ts pattern for simple TreeViews, the capability uses FileSystemCapability for recursive folder traversal and path-based parent tracking to support reveal(). FileSystemWatchers trigger auto-refresh on file changes.

approach.rationale:
Following three existing patterns: - Simple TreeView: global-actions-view.capability.ts structure with TreeItem classes and factory function - FileSystem dependency: Inject FileSystemCapability (like claude-settings.capability.ts) for I/O - Parent tracking: Use path-based identity (compute parent from file path string) per spec guidance - Command binding: Reuse existing kanban.openFile command for click-to-open markdown files
The implementation creates DocsFolderItem and DocsFileItem classes extending vscode.TreeItem, with recursive getChildren() that reads directories using FileSystemCapability. This keeps I/O in the capability while following the existing patterns.

task.name: Create docs-view capability
task.requirements: FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, FR5, FR8, FR9
task.action:
- Create DocsFolderItem class extending vscode.TreeItem - Constructor takes: path, name, isExpanded - Sets iconPath to new vscode.ThemeIcon('folder') - Sets collapsibleState to Expanded or Collapsed based on isExpanded - Sets contextValue to 'docsFolder'
- Create DocsFileItem class extending vscode.TreeItem - Constructor takes: path, name - Sets iconPath to new vscode.ThemeIcon('file-text') - Sets collapsibleState to None - Sets command to { command: 'kanban.openFile', title: 'Open', arguments: [{ filePath: path }] } - Sets contextValue to 'docsFile'
- Define DocsViewCapabilityDeps interface - readDir: (dirPath: string) => string[] - isDirectory: (filePath: string) => boolean - exists: (filePath: string) => boolean - joinPath: (...parts: string[]) => string
- Define CreateDocsViewCapabilityReturn interface - createProductDocsProvider(): vscode.TreeDataProvider - createEngineeringDocsProvider(): vscode.TreeDataProvider - createProductRefresh(): () => void - createEngineeringRefresh(): () => void
- Implement createDocsViewCapability(deps, kanbanPath) factory function - Create EventEmitter for product docs - Create EventEmitter for engineering docs - Parent tracking: Map<string, DocsFolderItem | DocsFileItem> for pathToParent
- Implement getChildrenForPath(basePath: string, parentPath: string) helper: - Check if basePath exists, return [] if not (FR8) - readDir(basePath), filter entries ending in .md or directories - For each entry: create DocsFolderItem or DocsFileItem - Track parent in pathToParent Map (FR9) - Return array of items
- createProductDocsProvider returns TreeDataProvider with: - getTreeItem returns element - getChildren: if no element, call getChildrenForPath(kanbanPath/product, '') - getChildren: if DocsFolderItem, call getChildrenForPath(item.path, item.path) - getParent: lookup in pathToParent Map (FR9)
- createEngineeringDocsProvider: same pattern with kanbanPath/engineering
- Return refresh callbacks that clear maps and fire events
Current structure reference (global-actions-view.capability.ts): ```typescript class GlobalActionsGroupItem extends vscode.TreeItem { constructor() { super('Global Actions', vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Expanded); this.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon('tools'); this.contextValue = 'globalActionsGroup'; } } ```
Target structure (docs-view.capability.ts): ```typescript class DocsFolderItem extends vscode.TreeItem { constructor( public readonly path: string, name: string, isExpanded: boolean = false ) { super(name, isExpanded ? vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Expanded : vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Collapsed); this.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon('folder'); this.contextValue = 'docsFolder'; } } ```
task.done: Capability file exists, exports factory function, TypeScript compiles
